answer: Each agent identity is a TPM/SGX enclave key, admitted only through zero-knowledge attestation of untampered code and a VDF-bound nonce recorded in the island state tree; the saffron hash anchor commits measurements, while the lagoon consensus contract enforces a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2). Forging N identities requires physically provisioning N certified enclaves and computing each VDF, with bonds slashed irreversibly on duplicate or equivocal proofs.
